[04-product-ridgeline.md]
# Product: Ridgeline
The Ridgeline is an electric mountain bike. Price: $2,800. Motor: 500 W. Range: 80 km on one charge. Weight: 24 kg.


[11-recall-2025.md]
# Ridgeline recall, August 2025
In August 2025 Brightwater recalled 1,340 Ridgeline bikes built between February and May 2025. Battery cells from the supplier VoltCore could overheat during fast charging. No injuries were reported. Affected owners received a free replacement battery.


[01-overview.md]
# Brightwater Cycles: company overview
Brightwater Cycles designs and sells electric bikes. The head office is in Port Alder. The company was founded in 2016. It sells three models: the Commuter, the Ridgeline and the Cargo Lite. Bikes are sold directly online and through 40 partner shops.


[02-history.md]
# Company history
Maya Okafor and Tomasz Wren founded Brightwater Cycles in 2016 in a rented garage in Port Alder. The first bike, the Commuter, shipped in 2017. The Ridgeline followed in 2020 and the Cargo Lite in 2023. In 2024 the company opened a second factory in Lindqvist.


[08-revenue-q3-2025.md]
# Q3 2025 results
Revenue in the third quarter of 2025 (July to September) was $6.1 million. The Ridgeline recall cost $0.4 million. That cost is recorded as an expense; it does not reduce the revenue figure.

steps.output:
[11-recall-2025.md]
# Ridgeline recall, August 2025
In August 2025 Brightwater recalled 1,340 Ridgeline bikes built between February and May 2025. Battery cells from the supplier VoltCore could overheat during fast charging. No injuries were reported. Affected owners received a free replacement battery.


[17-sustainability.md]
# Sustainability report 2025
In 2025, 62 percent of the aluminium in Brightwater frames was recycled. The target is 80 percent by 2027. The battery take-back programme collected 410 used battery packs in 2025.


[12-suppliers.md]
# Suppliers
Since October 2025, battery cells come from Nordcell, which replaced VoltCore after the Ridgeline recall. Motors come from Kessler Drive. Frames are welded in-house at the Port Alder and Lindqvist factories.


[13-warranty.md]
# Warranty
Frames are covered for 7 years. Batteries are covered for 2 years or 800 charge cycles, whichever comes first. Motors are covered for 3 years. Owners of recalled Ridgeline bikes had their battery warranty extended to 4 years.


[15-pricing-2026.md]
# Price change, March 2026
From 1 March 2026 the price of the Ridgeline rises by 8 percent, because Nordcell battery cells cost more than the old cells. The prices of the Commuter and the Cargo Lite do not change.
